67ded7a95f26137d3bf1: A Cyborg can mount Modules with different functions. The number of implants they can accommodate depends on the Grade of their Racial Technique, Mechanical Body.
6aac6fa477124239116d: Normal biological healing and Medicine healing do not recover HP.
b1c336ea49adc452159a: The Cyborg's Racial Attribute is d8 Strength. It represents the power of their physical structure, reinforced by artificial components.
1932a0912e028b2d13a1: Strength also determines Passive Defence. At creation:
2ba39d3746b278ec0fa5: If Strength grows through AP, Passive Defence also increases. Its development is separate from Mechanical Body.
182bed23876eb08786f6: A Cyborg starts with 16 HP and has a d8 Hit Die.
6f962f85e7052bb5ff37: At each Upgrade, they add half the Hit Die's maximum value, gaining +4 Maximum HP.
d399973288dafdd42f79: The Race does not automatically grant greater speed. Movement changes can come from Modules or other abilities expressly providing this effect.
5b47f3eb971d7f5ea7ff: Every Cyborg has d6 Mechanical Body.
71883b01870e4ced968e: Mechanical Body represents the character's level of technological integration and determines two values:
181b3d7a1905dd1d6f28: the maximum number of installed Modules;
c48878ba63087d794557: the highest Module Technology Tier the body can support.
ae9d8be3c436db690b68: Mechanical Body grows through AP along the normal progression:
cedc368e98bf49b44251: A Cyborg can install Modules of their Technology Tier or a lower Tier.
2f739d8d99fee77fa777: Having a free slot does not allow installation of a Module in a higher Tier than Mechanical Body.
5ecae396ca697da43fba: Unlocking a new slot does not automatically grant a new Module.
3f567f76ba5540d8b459: No initial purchase or construction cost.
9640bd7620a0a77a5fa0: The two Modules are chosen in the Workshop during pirate management. They can come from the catalogue or be projects agreed with the Game Master.
